name: Peterson SFB
description: Peterson SFB is home to Space Base Delta 1, U.S. Space Command headquarters, and NORAD/USNORTHCOM in the Colorado Springs metro area. The installation hosts more than 100 mission partners supporting space operations, missile warning, and national defense at 6,035 feet elevation adjacent to Colorado Springs Airport.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your Unit Command Support Staff (CSS) normal business hours (Mon-Fri 0730-1630). Attend the Right Start newcomers briefing at the Military & Family Readiness Center. Visit Finance for travel voucher settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact the Housing Management Office before arrival. All personnel must visit HMO before signing any off-base lease. Pikes Peak Lodge offers temporary lodging — book early during PCS season.

sections.title: Gate Access
sections.body: West Gate is open 24/7. East Gate is Mon-Fri 0500-1800 and Sat-Sun 0800-1800. North Gate inbound Mon-Fri 0600-0900 and outbound Mon-Fri 0600-1800 — closed weekends. Visitor Control Center hours are Mon-Fri 0700-1600. REAL ID required for all visitors.
